# CommunityConnect

> Hyperlocal Community Issue Mapping & Resolution Portal

CommunityConnect is a civic engagement web application that empowers residents to report, track, and monitor real-world neighborhood and locality issues (such as waste management, potholed roads, broken street lighting, water leakage, and drainage blockages). Administrators review reports, coordinate field resolutions, and upload photographic resolution evidence.

## Core Features
- Resident Issue Reporting: Geospatial coordinates, category selection, severity indicator, and photo evidence upload.
- Community Issue Map: Interactive OpenStreetMap/Leaflet integration visualizing issues by status and severity.
- Resolution Proof & Before/After Comparison: Transparent visual accountability with verified admin resolution imagery.
- Dynamic Impact Metrics: Real-time calculation of total issues, resolution rate %, pending queue, and average resolution turnaround.
- Community Priority Index (CPI): A transparent rule-based algorithm (Severity Base + Hazard Boost + Age Penalty) ensuring urgent civic issues are prioritized.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Leaflet, OpenStreetMap, Lucide Icons, Modular CSS.
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL Database, Authentication, Row-Level Security, Storage).
- Free-tier compliant: Optimized queries, zero paid extensions.

## Public Endpoints
- `/` - Homepage with live statistics, category browser, and recently resolved showcases.
- `/issues` - Public community issue directory with search, category filtering, and status filters.
- `/issues/:id` - Detailed issue page with timeline, map coordinates, and before/after verification.
- `/map` - Geospatial issue map visualization.
- `/report` - Issue submission portal for authenticated community residents.
- `/login` & `/register` - Community resident and admin authentication.
